entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Publish with `--no-build --no-restore` fails when using AOT in .NET 10 #121669
  • Several JIT.HardwareIntrinsics.Arm._Sve2.Program tests failing in the outerloop #121659
  • [API Proposal]: Add support for `ValueTypes` when using `UnsafeAccessorTypeAttribute` #121655

Closed

  • JIT: Redundant bound check #111027
    11.0.0
  • .NET 10: COM interop: IDispatchEx RCWs no longer support IReflect #121635
    11.0.0
  • Strange check in 'System.Reflection.NullabilityInfoContext'. #121654
    Future
  • The type initializer for 'System.Windows.Forms.ScaleHelper' threw exception #121615
  • Static extension members cannot be resolvable when "using static SomeType;" #121661
  • .NET 10 changes the way nested try-finally are handled #121578
    10.0.x
  • Step over bug is back (.NET 9) #121478

PullRequests

Created

  • JIT: Support async contexts for OSR/EnC #121672
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, runtime-async
  • Remove unsafe code from Uri PrivateParseMinimal, CheckAuthorityHelper, and related helpers #121671
    area-System.Net, reduce-unsafe, 11.0.0
  • [release/8.0-staging] Backport Replace test certificate chain that uses RSA+SHA-1 #121670
    area-System.Security, 8.0.x
  • [release/9.0-staging] Backport Replace test certificate chain that uses RSA+SHA-1 #121668
    area-System.Security, 9.0.x
  • [release/10.0] Backport Replace test certificate chain that uses RSA+SHA-1 #121665
    Servicing-consider, area-System.Security, 10.0.x
  • Bump js-yaml from 4.1.0 to 4.1.1 in /src/native #121660
    needs-area-label, javascript, dependencies
  • Remove unsafe code in CreateUriInfo and fix edge-case IndexOutOfRangeExceptions #121653
    area-System.Net, reduce-unsafe, 11.0.0
  • Remove unsafe code from Guid.TryFormat #121652
    area-System.Runtime, reduce-unsafe

Merged

  • Remove 16 unused DEFINE_METHOD identifiers, orphaned methods and classes, and unused metasig signatures #121650
  • Disable TLS optimization for musl riscv64 #121662
    area-PAL-coreclr, community-contribution, arch-riscv
  • Fix collided unwind detection #121625
    area-ExceptionHandling-coreclr, 10.0.x
  • Add runtime async support to reflection dataflow analysis #121628
    linkable-framework, area-NativeAOT-coreclr, runtime-async

Updated

  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 679: Build ID 2840029 #121062
    area-Infrastructure-libraries
  • Rename AsyncMethodKind enum values: NotAsync→Ordinary, RuntimeAsync→TaskReturningILAsync #121649
    area-VM-coreclr, runtime-async
  • [RyuJit/WASM] Crossgen2 integration and further factoring #121563
    arch-wasm, area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Extend the "skip-test" optimization to all instructions that modify the #120876
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Add support for DOTNET prefix on ICorProfiler env vars (#117902) #121646
    enhancement, area-Diagnostics-coreclr
  • [Helix] ReAdd AzureLinux Arm64 Queues #121648
    needs-area-label
  • Remove bounds checks for Phi indices #121640
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Emit IL for AsyncResumptionStub #121456
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr, runtime-async
  • [Wasm RyuJIT] Implement Wasm DFS and Loop Finding #121457
    arch-wasm, area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Add support for runtime async in the scanner #121622
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr, runtime-async
